correctness.rationale: Rank-one matrices are parameterized by image/kernel projective lines and a nonzero scalar. The adjacency criterion is exact. The symbolic rectangle argument excludes every dominating set of size at most \(q\) for \(q>2\), while an explicit two-vertex set works for \(q=2\). The verifier independently confirms the two smallest actual matrix graphs.
